# Product photo library

Store product photography by product line, then by product slug:

`products/<product-line>/<product-slug>/<product-slug>-<view>-<finish>.webp`

Examples:

- `products/system-furniture/sls/sls-670-pro-front-black.webp`
- `products/system-furniture/sls/sls-670-bench-workspace-oak.webp`
- `products/seatings/freedom/freedom-chair-front-black.webp`

## Shared structure

- Listing image: 1600 × 1200 px, 4:3, centered product, neutral light-grey background.
- Gallery image: 2000 × 1500 px, 4:3, identical camera scale within one product.
- Lifestyle hero: 2400 × 1500 px minimum, no embedded text or logos.
- Keep 8–12% safe space around the product and use a natural contact shadow.
- Use lowercase filenames with hyphens; add the finish name only when the image changes by finish.

## Product-specific data

Photo structure is shared, but finishes, dimensions, specifications, gallery scale, and add-ons must be set for each product. Do not copy one SLS model's specifications or color list to another.
